@@U00643@@
Praise her to the skies! Who cares? I'll have the last laugh, at least. She led me on the same as she'll lead you. Oh, I wish her a randy goblin for a sweetheart, who'll plow her field all night where two roads cross! I wish her a goat to bleat her a fond goodnight with a fart on his way home from the witches’ jamboree! A decent man of flesh and blood’s too good for that crusty bitch. The only greeting she'll have from me is a brick aimed straight at her window!

@@U00645@@
(Pounding the table.)

@@U00646@@
Gentlemen! Gentlemen! Your attention! Order in the house, if you please! Admit, gentlemen, I’ve an inside track on patching things up: I know what's right. Now! Here we have a pair of lovelorn losers, and it’s for me to send them off as friends. All right, now, pay attention! It’s brand new, and join in loud as you can at the chorus.

@@U00647@@
(Sings.)

@@U00648@@
In a cellar once There lived a rat, A rat that ate nothing But lard and fat. So fat he grew That he had a pot As big as Doctor Luther's got. The cook spread poison Around one night, And that rat’s world Closed in so tight, He thought he had love in his belly.
translation:
@@U00643@@
为她点赞上天！谁在乎？至少我会笑到最后。她带领我就像她带领你一样。哦，我希望她有一个好色的小妖精做情人，她会在两条路交叉的地方整晚耕田！我希望她有一只山羊，在从女巫聚会回家的路上放个屁，向她道个美好的晚安！一个有血有肉的正派男人对那个脾气暴躁的贱人来说太好了。她从我这里得到的唯一问候就是一块砖头直接瞄准她的窗户！

@@U00645@@
（拍桌子。）

@@U00646@@
先生们！先生们！您的关注！如果您愿意的话，可以在家里订购！先生们，承认吧，我有一个解决问题的内行：我知道什么是对的。现在！这里有一对失恋的失败者，我应该以朋友的身份送行。好吧，现在，注意！这是全新的，请尽可能大声地加入合唱团。

@@U00647@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00648@@
从前，在一个地窖里，住着一只老鼠，一只只吃猪油和脂肪的老鼠。他长得太胖了，以至于他有一个像路德医生的锅一样大的锅。厨子在一个晚上撒下了毒药，那只老鼠的世界紧紧地封闭着，他以为自己肚子里有爱。
